summary.plain: In its first engineering run, with only 1.5 months of beam, CCM saw no excess of events from light dark matter and ruled out a range of leptophobic dark-matter masses between about 9 and 50 MeV.
summary.technical: CCM120 engineering run (Fall 2019, 17.9e20 protons on target): observed events compatible with the expected background of 115,005; for m_V/m_chi = 2.1, dark-matter masses 9 MeV to 50 MeV excluded at 90 % CL in a baryonic vector-portal model (Feldman-Cousins).

title: First Leptophobic Dark Matter Search from Coherent CAPTAIN-Mills
why_it_matters: The first dark-sector limit from a liquid-argon detector at the Lujan neutron source, reaching previously unexplored light-dark-matter parameter space after only 1.5 months of data.
